purpose: Record how the three flow-meter covers fit and which ones showed incomplete seating on the bench.
tried: Derek compared flow-meter covers with wing crests at +0.00 mm, +0.20 mm and +0.40 mm relative to the original points.
said: So on this flow meter cover +0.40 mm fits better than +0.20 mm and +0.20 mm fits better than +0.00 mm, but on both +0.40 mm and +0.20 mm we are getting clear evidence of failing to fully seat that we don't have on the others. I think it is perhaps to do with the fancy edges on the cylinder face making our scan to model process not as precise as we'd like.
observed: The +0.40 mm cover fit best overall. Both raised covers showed incomplete seating.
hypothesis: Derek suspects the scan-to-model process may have reproduced the edges of the cylinder face imprecisely.
next_trial: Keep the +0.40 mm wing crests and add 0.40 mm of clearance at the cover saddle. Compare seating with the earlier +0.40 mm cover.
